meaning: A second route to Jesus' claim: Mark 2.10 attributes to Jesus the Son of Man's authority to forgive sins on earth; by open bridges, Jesus himself made the assertion, used the title of himself, and so claimed divine authority. Each of the four premises is needed (omission models in ROUND3-CHRIST-CHURCH-CONTROLS). The syntactic single-application heuristic flags this proof (its last step applies the interpretation bridge); by logical shape (#1214) it is a chain through the distinct middle term Speech.assertedAuthority, which only the report-to-event bridge supplies, so no premise states the conclusion. Not rewritten to evade the heuristic.
